faq.title: Questions & Answers
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our personal ride service in Frankfurt am Main.
faq.moreQuestionsSub: Message Obazee Clement directly via WhatsApp – we reply in under 5 minutes.
faq.q1: How does pickup at Frankfurt Airport (FRA) work?
faq.a1: Your driver Obazee Clement will be waiting for you in the arrival area (Terminal 1 or 2) holding a personalized name sign. We track your flight number in real time so no extra fees occur if your flight is delayed.
faq.q2: Are there any hidden costs or extra charges for traffic jams?
faq.a2: No. All stated fares are transparent fixed prices. If there is traffic or delay in the Frankfurt area, your price remains 100% guaranteed.
faq.q3: How much luggage fits in the vehicles?
faq.a3: Our Premium Electric Sedan holds 4 passengers & 2 suitcases, the Premium SUV holds 6 passengers & 4 suitcases, and our Comfort Van offers space for up to 8 passengers & 6 large suitcases.
faq.a4: You pay flexibly on-site to the driver in cash, with any major debit/credit card (including Apple Pay / Google Pay), or in advance via bank transfer / PayPal.
faq.q5: Can I cancel or change my booking at short notice?
faq.a5: You can change or cancel your booking easily and free of charge directly via WhatsApp up to 2 hours before pickup.
